facts.text: I have been feeling overwhelmed and stressed out lately.
I have been doing exercise and meditation.
I still feel anxious even after doing exercise and meditation.
I have been feeling anxious for about three months.
My anxiety started after I got into a car accident on my way to work.
I have recurring nightmares and flashbacks since the car accident.
The recurring nightmares and flashbacks make it hard for me to fall asleep or relax.
I want to write about the car accident and my emotions.
It has been hard for me to talk about the car accident with anyone, even my partner.
I think writing about the accident will help me process everything.
I want to focus on self-care and prioritize things that make me feel better.
I want to set goals for myself.
I want to exercise three times a week.
I want to practice meditation daily.
I want to set realistic and achievable goals so I do not feel too overwhelmed.
I want to start with small goals.
I want to exercise three times a week.
I want to practice meditation for 10 minutes, five days a week.
I want to prioritize self-care activities like taking a warm bath.
I want to prioritize self-care activities like reading a book before bed.
I do not want to share my goals with anyone yet.
I want to focus on myself and make sure I am committed to my goals before sharing them with others.
I am not sure if I am ready to talk about my anxiety and PTSD with others yet.
My anxiety and PTSD are a personal and sensitive topic for me.
